submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE independent native HD>=1024 square RGBA transparent game-animation frame. Image1 is the edit target: retain exact head/hair, torso, both arms sleeves hands weapons and canvas scale/position. Redraw ONLY legs and adjoining skirt fabric. Image2 is same-character leg anatomy reference. Image3 is approved grounding anatomy only, never copy its identity, bow, clothes. Image4 identity; image5 approved painted style. DIRECTION N pure rear view running away. Anatomical RIGHT hand sword must remain on screen-right, LEFT hand blue rectangular talisman on screen-left. Exactly two connected legs, short original limb proportions. Frame08 RIGHT-support rear push B. Image1 right foot too flat/static; redraw ONLY right lower leg/boot and left swing leg. RIGHT foot farther rearward than07 with heel visibly raised about half boot-height, ball/toe still pressed down at rear world-ground point below/right pelvis, show partial blue underside like right leg image2, not whole shoe airborne. Left knee advances deeper/front and ankle begins reaching forward, still off ground. Keep one sword and original head/arms. Same support foot must stay loaded on the world ground for 8 frames, with four progressive fore-aft ground positions, two independent poses per position. In rear view ground depth changes projected shoe height; never force all shoe-bottoms to a horizontal line. Keep feet axes straight NORTH, no outward toe yaw. Natural bent knees and meaningful weight; no standing mannequin, no extra limbs, no whole-character translation or scale change. Never move head or arms to compensate. Genuine transparent alpha; no shadow, guide, text, contact line or background.
